calls.statement:
SELECT p.category, fs.week_ending_date,
       SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units,
       SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fs.week_ending_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY p.category, fs.week_ending_date
ORDER BY fs.week_ending_date

WITH weekly_stock AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
         SUM(fs.closing_value) AS weekly_closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fs.week_ending_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY fs.week_ending_date
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weekly_closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value_eur,
       COUNT(*) AS weeks_in_period
FROM weekly_stock
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM dim_product WHERE category LIKE '%Paint%' OR category LIKE '%Decorat%'

-- Verify the data we're aggregating
SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fs.store_key) AS stores_with_stock,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fs.product_key) AS products_in_stock,
       COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fs.week_ending_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
GROUP BY fs.week_ending_date
ORDER BY fs.week_ending_date

-- Final query: Average stock value at cost for Paint & Decorating, P3 FY2025/26, whole chain
WITH weekly_stock AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
         SUM(fs.closing_value) AS weekly_closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fs.week_ending_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  GROUP BY fs.week_ending_date
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weekly_closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value
FROM weekly_stock
